action: If Uber notifies you, follow its instructions, consider a fraud alert or credit freeze because licence numbers were taken, and be wary of messages asking you to confirm personal details.
exec: A supplier breach exposed identity data for about 150,000 people, bringing notification duties and fraud risk.
plain: Names, addresses and driver's licence numbers of about 150,000 people were stolen from Uber through an outside company that provides services to it.
summary: Names, addresses and driver's licence numbers of about 150,000 people were stolen through a compromised third-party services provider. A separate headline ties exposed Uber data to the Fireworks AI breach; that link is not confirmed in what was read.
title: Uber data breach affects 150,000 people through a third-party provider

validation.note: Specific SecurityWeek article located; search text also cites state notifications and a TechCrunch spokesperson confirmation. Primary state filing not read.
